Convert a response to a tibble

Source: R/columns.R
as_tibble.ts_response.Rd

Turns a ts_response into a one-row tibble with the same answer columns that system_one_df() adds, so single requests and data frames can be handled the same way.

Arguments

x

A ts_response.

...

Unused.

probs

If TRUE, also add a <name>_probs list-column for each choice and score answer.

include_usage

If TRUE, also add input_tokens and output_tokens columns.

Value

A one-row tibble.

Examples

resp <- ts_response(
  answers = list(
    urgent = ts_answer_noul(prob = 0.95),
    team = ts_answer_choice(
      choice = "billing",
      probabilities = c(billing = 0.88, technical = 0.12),
      confidence = 0.81
    )
  ),
  model = "jev-1.13.0",
  usage = c(input_tokens = 318L, output_tokens = 34L)
)
as_tibble(resp)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   urgent team    team_confidence
#>    <dbl> <chr>             <dbl>
#> 1   0.95 billing            0.81
as_tibble(resp, probs = TRUE, include_usage = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   urgent team    team_confidence team_probs input_tokens output_tokens
#>    <dbl> <chr>             <dbl> <list>            <int>         <int>
#> 1   0.95 billing            0.81 <dbl [2]>           318            34
